# Font Weight

字重。标题常用 `font-semibold`。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: font-light
    tpl: light
  - type: tpl
    className: font-medium
    tpl: medium
  - type: tpl
    className: font-bold
    tpl: bold
```

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `font-thin` | `100` |

| `font-normal` | `400` |
| `font-medium` | `500` |
| `font-semibold` | `600` |
| `font-bold` | `700` |
